migration_steps.activity: Establish PQC migration programme governance, inventory cryptographic assets (RSA-2048 at rest via AWS KMS, ECDSA in TLS 1.3, Java Spring Boot microservices, Bouncy Castle usage), and define crypto-agility requirements.

Access to source code repositories and SBOM

migration_steps.activity: Engage the demanding customer (30% revenue) to agree a 9-month interim PQC compliance definition covering hybrid TLS (ML-KEM) and ML-DSA signatures where feasible, with documented residual risk for KMS-dependent at-rest encryption.
prerequisites: Legal and compliance review of customer contract

migration_steps.activity: Validate Bouncy Castle PQC provider versions (ML-KEM and ML-DSA) in a Java Spring Boot staging environment; confirm JCA provider integration, TLS library compatibility, and performance impact.
prerequisites: Bouncy Castle PQC-capable release identified and licensed

migration_steps.activity: Implement hybrid post-quantum TLS (X25519MLKEM768 or equivalent ML-KEM hybrid group) for service-to-service and external TLS 1.3 endpoints using Bouncy Castle and supported TLS libraries; retain ECDSA certificates during transition.
prerequisites: Load balancer and ingress TLS stack supports hybrid groups

migration_steps.activity: Implement ML-DSA digital signatures for internal service authentication, audit log signing, and software artefact signing using Bouncy Castle; define key lifecycle and rotation procedures.
prerequisites: Key management policy for ML-DSA keys defined

Produce customer-facing PQC compliance evidence pack: hybrid TLS deployment, ML-DSA usage, residual risk statement for AWS KMS at-rest encryption pending 2027 ML-KEM support, and migration roadmap.
prerequisites: Legal review of residual risk statement

migration_steps.activity: Deploy hybrid post-quantum TLS and ML-DSA changes to production in phased rollout with rollback capability, respecting change freezes and zero-downtime constraints.
prerequisites: Step 7 evidence pack accepted by customer

migration_steps.activity: Deliver interim PQC compliance attestation to the demanding customer covering hybrid TLS and ML-DSA, with documented dependency on AWS KMS ML-KEM support for at-rest encryption.
Monitor AWS KMS ML-KEM support announcement (forecast 2027); prepare integration design for ML-KEM at-rest encryption and key wrapping once AWS confirms availability and API details.
prerequisites: AWS public roadmap and API documentation

migration_steps.activity: Upon AWS KMS ML-KEM availability, validate ML-KEM key wrapping in staging, migrate at-rest encryption keys, and complete full PQC posture for data at rest.
prerequisites: AWS KMS ML-KEM support confirmed and documented
Staging validation of KMS ML-KEM APIs

blockers.blocker: AWS KMS does not currently support ML-KEM for encryption at rest; support is forecast for 2027.
blockers.reason: RSA-2048 at-rest encryption via AWS KMS cannot be replaced with ML-KEM until AWS delivers and documents the capability; no workaround preserves KMS-managed key semantics.
blockers.resolution_required: AWS public confirmation of ML-KEM support in KMS, API documentation, and availability in the provider's AWS region; then staging validation.

blockers.blocker: Hybrid ML-KEM TLS support depends on load balancers, ingress controllers, and TLS libraries in the microservice mesh.
blockers.reason: Bouncy Castle supports ML-KEM at the library level, but end-to-end TLS requires every terminating endpoint to negotiate hybrid groups; unsupported components would downgrade to classical ECDHE.
blockers.resolution_required: Inventory of all TLS terminators; vendor confirmation of hybrid group support; staging interoperability test results.

blockers.blocker: The demanding customer's definition of 'PQC compliance' is not yet agreed and may require at-rest PQC that is impossible before 2027.
blockers.reason: Without an agreed interim compliance definition, the 9-month deadline cannot be objectively satisfied and contractual risk remains.
blockers.resolution_required: Written customer acceptance of interim scope (hybrid TLS + ML-DSA) with documented residual risk for KMS at-rest encryption.

blockers.blocker: Production deployment must respect change freezes and zero-downtime constraints.
blockers.reason: Hybrid TLS and ML-DSA changes affect all microservice connections; a misconfiguration could cause outage.
blockers.resolution_required: Change advisory board approval, phased rollout plan, feature flags, and validated rollback procedure.

blockers.blocker: Team familiarity with Bouncy Castle exists, but PQC operational experience (ML-DSA key lifecycle, hybrid TLS debugging) is limited.
blockers.reason: Insufficient operational experience increases risk of misconfiguration and delayed incident resolution.
blockers.resolution_required: Targeted training, runbooks, and external PQC assurance review completed before production.

algorithm_roles.ML-DSA: Post-quantum digital signatures for service authentication, audit log signing, software artefact signing, and certificate signatures where supported.
